description: This old-style game is a retro labyrinth maze! You have got a ball, we have a map. Can you go through the map avoiding any mines and traps? Now with more than 10 maps, and later new maps will come by updates! If you have tablet, you can control by tablet sensors, by tilting the device, or you can control by touch/mouse by taping on the map. Good luck! Hope you will like the game, and share with us your feelings and ideas on facebook: www.facebook.com/GapetMobile
